architectureMarkdown.description: Layered architecture write-up. May embed ```mermaid blocks; the workbench renders them natively after sanitizing the Markdown.

totalTasks.description: Legacy optional display statistic. New TECH_SPEC runs do not produce work-order breakdowns.

frontendTasks.description: Legacy optional display statistic; not recalculated by the control plane.

backendTasks.description: Legacy optional display statistic; not recalculated by the control plane.

middlewareTasks.description: Legacy optional display statistic; not recalculated by the control plane.

totalDevDays.description: Legacy optional display statistic; not recalculated by the control plane.

databaseTables.description: Physical or logical data models assembled from data/tables.json. Browser-only solutions may describe local data structures and state explicitly that server databases are not applicable.

apiEndpoints.description: HTTP endpoints or local/view adapter contracts assembled from data/apis.json. Method labels are preserved, not converted into HTTP endpoints.

tech_spec_files.description: Assembled TECH_SPEC pack. Keys are relative POSIX paths (README.md, architecture.md, data/*.json, modules/*). Historical results may omit this field.

tasks.description: Legacy work orders. New runs should omit this field; if present for historical results, items must be objects.

items.description: Text or structured index intent, displayed without modifying the stored result.

method.description: Method or adapter label, including HTTP methods, LOCAL and VIEW. The control plane does not infer or rewrite a transport.

requestBody.description: Compact JSON sample serialized as a string, not a nested object.

responseBody.description: Compact JSON sample serialized as a string, not a nested object.

errorCodes.description: Original error-code text or structured list; consumers render as text without normalization.

taskId.description: Work order number such as DEV-BE-001. The producer should submit the canonical taskId field; compatibility aliases are not rewritten.

module.description: First-level module supplied by the producer. The control plane does not synthesize it.

name.description: Task name. The producer should submit the canonical name field; compatibility aliases are only read for validation.

type.description: Canonical side of the work supplied by the producer. The control plane does not normalize synonyms.

priority.description: Canonical priority supplied by the producer. The control plane does not normalize synonyms.

devDays.description: Development effort in person-days. The producer should submit the canonical devDays field; aliases are not rewritten.

dependencies.description: Preceding work order numbers supplied by the producer. If present, this field must be an array.

description.description: Implementation points supplied by the producer. The control plane does not synthesize a description.
